units.title: Introduction
topics: 1. Introduction of Estimation, Costing and contracting and their importance in industries.

2. Methods of costing (Explain actual examples for these methods) A. Specific order costing - Job costing - Contract costing - Batch costing B. Continuous operation costing - Process costing - Service costing - Operation costing - Unit costing
3. Calculation of catalogue price, selling price and various over heads (Only numerical).
4. Depreciation methods (1) Straight line method (2) Sinking fund method (Only numerical)
uos: 1.a. Explain terminology and importance of ECC in industries.

units.title: Break even analysis
topics: 1. Calculation of Break-even Quantity analytically and graphically (Only real time examples).
2. Safety Margin and it’s importance.
3. Assumptions and Limitations of BEA.
uos: 2.a. Construct break even chart and find various parameters.
2.b. Determine break even quantity for given data

units.title: Costing in forging and casting
topics: 1. Calculate volume of shapes of various combinations of cylinder, square, prism and sphere.
2. Calculate mass and material cost of given component (shape of component should be combination of above basic shapes like I- section, T-section, L-section, etc.).
3. List and calculate various forging losses for given data.
4. Estimate forging cost (for given data)
5. Estimate pattern making cost (for given data)
6. For a given component, Estimate casting Estimating, Costing and Engineering Contracting Machine Drawing Practice cost including all losses.
uos: 3.b. Estimate cost for a forging component
3.c. Estimate cost for a casting component

units.title: Costing in Fabrication shop
topics: 1. Estimation of fabrication cost of real time object like safety grill (e.g. windows, doors, etc.), gate, various shades, etc. (Sizes are given)
2. Estimate Solar Roof Top costing for various capacities. It includes, cost of welding, framing, solar panel, labour, taxes, subsidies, etc.

3. Estimate ONLY material cost in sheet metal work for various jobs. (Concept of development of solid surfaces to be used. Consider regular shapes like cylinder and prism only) (ONLY numerical to be covered in this chapter)
uos: 4.a. Estimate material and welding cost for a given component

units.title: Costing in Production shop
topics: 1. Calculate cost of various lathe operations like turning, facing, knurling etc.
2. Calculate cost of various drilling operations like drilling, boring, reaming, etc.
3. Calculate cost of shaping, grinding and milling operations. (ONLY numerical to be covered in this chapter)
uos: 5.a. Calculate machining cost in lathe, drilling, milling, shaping and grinding machines

units.title: Costing of various processes
topics: 1. Estimate the cost of furniture work for given data.
2. Calculate running cost of power plant.
3. Calculate running cost of refrigerator, air conditioners, lift, cold storage, DG set, etc. (ONLY numerical to be covered in this chapter)
uos: 6.a. Identify various elements . to estimate the process . cost
6.b. Estimate the cost of various processes

units.title: Budget and Contracting
topics: 1. Define budget. Objectives and advantages of budget.
2. Explain industrial budget with actual example.
3. Discuss Rail budget, Financial budget of State/country.
4. Budgetary control and it’s advantages.

5. Explain actual contracts. e.g. Housekeeping contract, Labour contract, Security contract, Annual Maintenance contract like CCTV, Lift, Diesel Generator set, water purifier, vehicle, computer system, etc.
6. Explain Tendering process and E-tendering Estimating, Costing and Engineering Contracting Machine Drawing Practice process. with real time example.
7. Explain about GeM (Government E Market). How to become seller or buyer on GeM.
uos: 4.f. Interpret given contract terms and conditions.
